summary: LuxExperience B.V. (NYSE:LUXE), formerly MYT Netherlands Parent, furnished a Form 6-K with its Q4/FY26 earnings release and disclosed that on September 3, 2026 management received authorization for a share repurchase program of up to $50 million of American Depositary Receipts. Q4 FY26 net sales rose 7.6% ex-FX to EUR 653.6 million with Adjusted EBITDA margin of 2.1%; cash and investments totaled EUR 442.7 million and the balance sheet was bank-debt-free. No price, premium or expiration terms were stated. Watch buyback execution pace, ADR liquidity and FY27 margin guidance.
